extracted.name: Homemade Caramel Latte
extracted.description: This caramel coffee latte recipe is tastier than Starbucks and simple to make on the stovetop with milk, brown sugar, caramel sauce, and vanilla.
instruction_lines: Combine milk and brown sugar in a saucepan over medium heat. Heat until frothy and close to simmering, about 3 minutes.
Reduce heat to low; whisk in caramel sauce and vanilla.
